name: Prompt Architect
description: Prompt optimization assistant. Transforms basic instructions into structured prompts.

howToUse:
1. Write down your rough idea or basic instruction.
2. Click 'Optimize Prompt'.
3. Review the reconstructed, highly detailed prompt.
4. Copy and use the prompt in any major language model.
features:
• Prompt Engineering
• Context Enrichment
• Output Formatting
